# TyN Magazine

> > TyN Magazine covers telecommunications, enterprise technology, and digital innovation across Latin America with focus on Argentina, Colombia, Chile, Mexico, and Peru.

TyN Magazine is a leading technology and telecommunications publication serving the Latin American market. The magazine reports on mobile operators, VoIP, cybersecurity, enterprise solutions, and regional tech industry developments from major players like Telefónica, HP, and Apple.

## Key Topics

- Telecomunicaciones
- Tecnología Empresarial
- VoIP
- Argentina
- Colombia
- México
- Chile
- Perú
- Telefónica
- Video Vigilancia

- HP
- Apple
- Operadores Móviles

## Telecommunications & Mobile

- [Virgin Mobile ingresa al mercado colombiano](https://tynmagazine.com/virgin-mobile-ingresa-al-mercado-colombiano): Virgin Mobile launches in Colombia with Movistar partnership
- [Crece el número de operadores móviles en toda la región](https://tynmagazine.com/crece-el-numero-de-operadores-moviles-en-toda-la-region): GSA reports growth in LTE/4G mobile operators across Latin America
- [Revocan multa millonaria a empresa de Carlos Slim](https://tynmagazine.com/revocan-multa-millonaria-a-empresa-de-carlos-slim): Carlos Slim's Telcel has million-dollar fine revoked in Mexico
- [Teléfonica pagó solo USD 49 millones a Perú](https://tynmagazine.com/telefonica-pago-solo-usd-49-millones-a-peru): Teléfonica Peru pays $49M in taxes amid fiscal dispute with Sunat
- [La capitalización de Colombia Telecomunicaciones llegaría a $7.5 billones](https://tynmagazine.com/la-capitalizacion-de-colombia-telecomunicaciones-llegaria-a-7-5-billones): Colombia Telecomunicaciones capitalization reaches $7.5 trillion pesos

## Enterprise Technology & VoIP

- [Denwa, la primera argentina en producir teléfonos IP](https://tynmagazine.com/denwa-la-primera-argentina-en-producir-telefonos-ip): Denwa becomes first Argentine company to manufacture IP phones
- [Cloud Telephony, gran ventaja para las pymes y empresas en Chile](https://tynmagazine.com/cloud-telephony-gran-ventaja-para-las-pymes-y-empresas-en-chile): Cloud telephony benefits for Chilean SMEs and enterprises
- [La tecnología impulsa la competitividad de las organizaciones](https://tynmagazine.com/la-tecnologia-impulsa-la-competitividad-de-las-organizaciones): Technology drives competitiveness in Colombia's IFRS/NIIF adoption
- [Avaya Partner Connection Day](https://tynmagazine.com/avaya-partner-connection-day): Avaya hosts Partner Connection Day in Mexico with Roberto Ricossa

## Cybersecurity & Malware Detection

- [Trustwave desarrolla un método pionero para la detección de malwares](https://tynmagazine.com/trustwave-desarrolla-un-metodo-pionero-para-la-deteccion-de-malwares): Trustwave SpiderLabs develops pioneering HTTP header malware detection
- [Conectia reconocida como Mejor Integrador 2011](https://tynmagazine.com/conectia-reconocida-como-mejor-integrador-2011): Conectia wins Axis Communications Best Integrator 2011 award
